copy_recommendations.detail: Wind uses a km/h value with a knots label; convert only Pirate by dividing by 1.852, retaining nautical character.
Three bells are not three hours. Use an unambiguous 3h label with a Pirate suffix; retain the rest of the voice.
Replace broken hybrid 'RSS-Feed wird sync...' with 'RSS wird synchronisiert...' and check wrapping.
Tusu means cough; the touch imperative is Tuŝu. Dosis supports ŝ. Preserve this distinction rather than stripping the accent.
Supported accents are retained in internal localized RSS messages. External article text alone keeps its established ASCII fallback.
Preserve Bellazio slang (boh/tipo/slay), Pirate phrasing and Shakespeare's Prithee/anon; do not turn stylistic choices into generic English/Italian.
Move the adverb: 'Everything you could check faster on your phone, but won't.' Keep the joke and tone.
INFO description currently refers to word clock, and Mac Stats omits network. Describe actual page contents.
